'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a female NPC employee for the [[Averado Bank]] stationed in Septimont, {{Location|Capitoline Hill}}. She can be found next to [[Raechyl]] and a Common Echo Mercurio.
__NOTOC__
==Location==
<gallery>Location Raechyl Shop.png|Located near by Averardo Bank Counter</gallery>

==Idle==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Day)
:'''Galby:''' I want to deposit this!
:'''Katvia:''' Seriously...? We can't do that!

==Dialogue==
;(Day)
:'''Galby:''' I want to deposit this. Katvia, deposit this for me!
:'''Katvia:''' All this meat...? This is a bank, not a meat locker!
----
;(Night)
:'''Katvia:''' What on earth is going on... What  did we do wrong?
:{{DIcon}} What's wrong?
:'''Katvia:''' Sigh... The Averardo Vault is opening a branch in Septimont, but it hasn't been going too well for us.
:'''Katvia:''' Everyone feels safe depositing their money with us, and they're happy to do business...
:'''Katvia:''' ...but some people want to store weird stuff, like fighting gear, poetry collections, random sculptures...
:'''Katvia:''' Someone even brought a bunch of meat here! I just... Why on earth would they do that?
{{Dialogue End}}
